cachedNews.title: Ethiopia Launches Digital Government Transformation Program
cachedNews.description: Ethiopia has launched a comprehensive digital government transformation program aimed at bringing all government services online by 2030, targeting 40% digital capability across the population.

cachedNews.title: MESOB Centers Expand to 200 Locations Nationwide
cachedNews.description: The Ministry of Revenues announces expansion of MESOB one-stop service centers to 200 locations across all regions of Ethiopia, bringing government services closer to rural communities.

cachedNews.title: Ethiopia Records 6.4% GDP Growth Despite Global Challenges
cachedNews.description: Ethiopia's economy grew by 6.4% in the fiscal year, driven by agriculture reforms, digital services expansion, and increased foreign direct investment in manufacturing sectors.

cachedNews.title: New Tax Reform Package Aims to Boost Revenue Collection by 35%
cachedNews.description: The Ministry of Revenues unveils comprehensive tax reform package including digital VAT collection, automated customs system, and expanded tax base targeting 35% revenue increase.

cachedNews.title: National ID Program Reaches 45 Million Registrations
cachedNews.description: Ethiopia's Fayda digital ID program has reached 45 million registrations, covering 35% of the population, with plans to reach 80 million by 2028 through expanded enrollment centers.

cachedNews.title: Ethiopia Telecom Sector Reaches 72 Million Subscribers
cachedNews.description: Ethiopia's telecom sector has reached 72 million mobile subscribers with 31 million internet users, as Ethio telecom and Safaricom Ethiopia continue to expand 4G coverage.

cachedNews.title: Digital Literacy Program Trains 2 Million Ethiopians
cachedNews.description: The Ministry of Education's digital literacy program has trained 2 million Ethiopians in basic digital skills, with a target of 10 million by 2028 to bridge the digital divide.

cachedNews.title: Ethiopian Investment Commission Approves $3.2B in New Projects
cachedNews.description: The Ethiopian Investment Commission approved $3.2 billion in new investment projects in Q1 2026, with significant interest in manufacturing, technology, and renewable energy sectors.

cachedNews.title: Healthcare Digitalization: 500 Hospitals Connected to National System
cachedNews.description: Ethiopia has connected 500 hospitals and 2,000 health centers to its national digital health information system, improving patient data management and healthcare delivery across the country.

cachedNews.title: Ethiopia's Agriculture Sector Embraces Digital Farming Solutions
cachedNews.description: Digital farming initiatives reach 500,000 Ethiopian farmers through mobile apps providing weather data, market prices, and agricultural extension services via smartphone platforms.
